verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own background automations: rules, webhooks and online evaluations for automating workflows; evaluators that run automatically on production traces with filters and sampling rates; threshold-based alerts that route to webhooks; and Engine, which automatically detects recurring issues. These run unattended once configured. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of automation-rule triggers and actions, scheduled or time-based jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations work reliably.
